title: Frozen S'more Bars with Torched Marshmallow Meringue
summary: A stunning layered frozen treat with a chocolate fudge base, vanilla ice cream centre, and a torched marshmallow meringue top.
equipment: heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Mix 120 g finely crushed digestive biscuits, 55 g melted butter and 1 tbsp sugar until like wet sand, press firmly into a 20 cm square tin lined with baking paper and bake at 160 °C for about 12 min until fragrant and lightly browned; cool completely.

steps.title: Fudge
steps.text: Microwave 115 g finely chopped dark chocolate (about 70%), 120 ml double cream and 60 ml golden syrup in 20 s bursts, stirring, until smooth, about 1 min. Cool to room temperature, 30 min, then pour over the base and freeze until firm, 30 min.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread 1000 ml slightly softened vanilla ice cream evenly on top, cover and freeze until very firm, at least 4 h.

steps.title: Stick
steps.text: Lift out, cut into 8 bars with a hot knife, push a stick into the end of each, and refreeze on a lined tray for 30 min.

steps.title: Meringue
steps.text: Whisk 4 large egg whites, 200 g sugar and a pinch of fine salt in a heatproof bowl over simmering water until the sugar dissolves and it reaches 71 °C. Move to a mixer and whisk on high until thick, glossy and cool, 5-7 min; beat in 1 tsp vanilla.

steps.title: Torch
steps.text: Working quickly, spread a thick layer of meringue over the top and sides of each bar. Torch until deep golden and charred in spots.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve at once, or freeze uncovered and torch again just before serving.

tips: Use a hot knife to cut the frozen bars cleanly without them cracking or tearing
Keep the blowtorch flame moving and stay away from the wooden sticks to prevent charring them
Work quickly when spreading meringue to prevent the frozen bars from melting during assembly
storage: Keep frozen; torch the meringue again just before serving if previously frozen after torching.
